exposure: type of delivery (vaginal or caesarean section)
outcome: Knowledge, Attitude, and Practices (KAP) on Breastfeeding
cohort: 500 recently delivered women who delivered vaginally or by caesarean section in a Department of Obstetrics and Gynaecology in the Bihar region were included in the study.
finding: 70% of women initiated breastfeeding within 1 hour of delivery, and various maternal and socioeconomic factors, including type of delivery, were found to be associated with breastfeeding initiation.
mod_finding: Type of delivery (vaginal or caesarean section) was identified as a factor determining the initiation of breastfeeding.
cross-section timing: Data was collected among recently delivered postpartum women.
